Пусть \(t=\sqrt{x+2},\ t\geq 0,\ t^{2}=x+2,\ x-2=t^{2}-4\).
\[(1) \Leftrightarrow \left\{\begin{array}{l} 3t\leq 6-\left|t^{2}-4\right|, \\ t\geq 0 \end{array}\right. \Leftrightarrow \left\{\begin{array}{l} \left|t^{2}-4\right|\leq 6-3t, \\ t\geq 0 \end{array}\right.\]
Так как \(\left|t^{2}-4\right|\geq 0\), то \(6-3t\geq 0\).
\[\left\{\begin{array}{l} \left|t^{2}-4\right|-(6-3t)\leq 0, \\ t\geq 0,\ 6-3t\geq 0 \end{array}\right. \Leftrightarrow \left\{\begin{array}{l} \left(t^{2}-4\right)^{2}-(6-3t)^{2}\leq 0, \\ t\in[0; 2] \end{array}\right. \Leftrightarrow\]

\[\left\{\begin{array}{l} (t+5)(t-2)(t-2)(t-1)\leq 0, \\ t\in[0; 2] \end{array}\right. \Leftrightarrow \left\{\begin{array}{l} (t-2)^{2}(t-1)\leq 0, \\ t\in[0; 2] \end{array}\right. \Leftrightarrow\]
\[\left\{\begin{array}{l} \left(\sqrt{x+2}-2\right)^{2}\left(\sqrt{x+2}-1\right)\leq 0, \\ \sqrt{x+2}\geq 0,\ \sqrt{x+2}\leq 2 \end{array}\right. \Leftrightarrow \left\{\begin{array}{l} (x+2-4)^{2}(x+2-1)\leq 0, \\ x+2\geq 0,\ x+2\leq 4 \end{array}\right. \Leftrightarrow\]
\[\left\{\begin{array}{l} (x-2)^{2}(x+1)\leq 0, \\ x\in[-2; 2] \end{array}\right.\]
